['Volkswagen Financial Services AG '].company_description: Volkswagen Financial Services AG is a subsidiary of the Volkswagen Group, which offers a range of financial services including financing, leasing, and fleet management for Volkswagen vehicles and other brands under the Volkswagen Group. The company provides financial products and services to support the sales of vehicles from the Volkswagen Group's various brands.

['Weltbild GmbH & Co. KG '].company_description: Weltbild GmbH & Co. KG operates as a major German publisher and media retailer based in Augsburg. It is a partner of the holding company DBH Deutsche Buch Handels GmbH & Co. KG, which competes for being the major book trading company in Germany with its rival Thalia. The company manages about 465 branches with about 3500 employees and is a significant player in the German publishing and media retail industry.
